record.question: All of the following are disadvantages of Radioimmunoassay, EXCEPT :
options: Picogram quantities of substances cannot be analysed
Shelf life of reagent is short
record.explanation: Official final key: A — Picogram quantities of substances cannot be analysed. MPSC notification 9 March 2026, Group B non-gazetted technical H&FW examination held 29 January–2 February 2026; key physical page 6, printed Q46. Source limitation: Multiple valid exceptions in printed choices. The final key establishes the historical marking choice without removing that limitation.
